chain_words.nuance: slightly wet, often cool or unpleasant
wet enough to feel soft, often used for food or cake
covered with water or another liquid
very wet all the way through
completely wet, as if water has been poured over something

explanation: These words all describe the presence of water, from slightly wet to completely soaked.

usage_notes.difference: 'Wet' is the general word for having water on something. 'Soaked' means the water has gone deep inside, so the thing is very wet all the way through.
